## Plan

1. `web/src/lib/reading-key.ts` — the lexicon-driven key model + `dossierReadingKey`.
2. `web/src/components/ReadingKey.astro` — the `<details>` key (component-scoped styles, zero shared-CSS weight).
3. `dossier/[...path].astro` — band action link `#reading-key` + the key mount.
4. `web/src/pages/about/how-to-read-a-dossier.astro` — the annotated page.
5. `lib/empty.ts` — `EMPTY_KIND_PARTS` + `emptyKindParts` + `emptyCauseCovered`; the component-kit harness mounts the registry.
6. `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-17.md` — 35 rows (KY/EK/HD), all `pending`.
7. Tests: `web/tests/unit/reading-key.test.ts`, `web/tests/unit/empty-kind.test.ts`, `web/tests/e2e/onboarding-content.spec.ts`, `tests/unit/test_p36_65_copy_batch.py`.
